date.as_written: saṃvat 1816 mī kārtīkamāse kṛṣna pakṣa ekādaśyāvāramaṃgarakelī

notes: The author is the well-known 18th-century tantric scholar Premanidhi Pantha (Premanidhi Śarman) of Kūrmācala (Kumaon), designated here as 'bhāradvājakulaprasūta yaṃtokanāmaka kūrmācalāśrita'. Scribe is unnamed ('ye deṣasi līṣā mama doṣo na dīyate').
